card.name: Inside long medical terms
card.fires_on: The pole responds partway through long medical words, most often the 'ous' in arteriovenous and venous, and the 'til' in tilting disk valves. It also fires on 'gall' before stones.

modes.label: venous endings
modes.description: The 'ous' ending of arteriovenous or venous in lists of vascular conditions.

modes.label: other word interiors
modes.description: Pieces in the middle of other medical words such as tilting, gallstones, Weber or a drug name.
